title: Manager-FDI-FINANCE TECH
jobDescription: At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. Manager – FDI EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance As a Manager in our EY Finance Consulting Team, you will lead client engagements focused on leveraging finance data intelligence and finance data lake solutions to drive strategic performance improvements. You will manage techno-functional assessments of finance data processes, lead analysis of data challenges, and design innovative, data-driven finance solutions. Your role will involve collaborating with senior client stakeholders across industries and geographies to unlock actionable insights from finance data and enable data-driven decision-making. The Opportunity We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process optimization. Candidates should have strong knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics. Experience in FP&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is highly desirable. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead and grow EY’s global finance data intelligence service offering. Your Key Responsibilities - Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting. - Drive workshops and stakeholder interviews to perform comprehensive current state (As-Is) finance data process assessments and design optimized future state processes leveraging finance data lakes and advanced analytics. - Identify and prioritize finance data process improvement opportunities through automation, data integration, technology upgrades, and finance data transformation initiatives. - Oversee the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and governance frameworks. - Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring and reporting across O2C, P2P, and R2R processes. - Translate complex business requirements into technical data models and solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives. - Lead data profiling, data quality assessments, and validation activities using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools. - Ensure comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables. - Collaborate with project managers, cross-functional teams, and senior client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. - Apply strong accounting expertise to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics and governance. - Provide guidance on financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration. - Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities with a focus on data accuracy and reconciliation. - Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures. - Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives. - Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects. - Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. - Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required. Skills and Attributes for Success - Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles. - Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels. - Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly. - Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments. - Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. - Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have - CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field. - 5-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain. - Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL. Ideally, You’ll Also Have - Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms. - Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives. - Project management certification or experience. - Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills. What We Look For - A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning. - A leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries. What Working at EY Offers At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer: - Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues. - Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career. - Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you. EY | Building a better working world EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets. Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobDescription: At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. Service line: SAP - Position Title: FS-CD Senior Consultant At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. About Global Delivery Services Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda. Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. The Opportunity As a Senior SAP FSCD (Financial Services Collections and Disbursements) professional, you will play a key role in optimizing financial processes within the organization. This position offers the chance to lead the implementation and enhancement of SAP FSCD solutions, driving improvements in collections, disbursements, and overall financial management. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure that financial operations align with business objectives and regulatory requirements. Your Key Responsibilities - Implementation: Lead the configuration and deployment of SAP FSCD solutions to meet business needs. - Process Optimization: Identify and implement best practices to enhance collections and disbursement processes. - Data Analysis: Analyze financial data to provide insights and support strategic decision-making. - Collaboration: Work with cross-functional teams to align financial processes with overall business strategies. - User Support: Provide training and support to end-users on FSCD functionalities and processes. - Troubleshooting: Address and resolve issues related to the FSCD module, ensuring system reliability and performance. - Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of configurations, processes, and user guides. Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution. Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals. Skills and attributes for success - SAP FS Collection and Disbursement (FSCD) with excellent understanding of Key accounting processes of FSCD and standards in insurance industry. - Should be familiar with integration of FS-CD with Key SAP insurance modules (FS-CM, FS-PM, FS-RI and FS-ICM) and SAP Finance modules SAP FI Experience with ECC GL and any financial General ledger experience relating to SAP insurance / banking products is added advantage. Ideally, you’ll also - Address and resolve issues related to the FSCD module, ensuring system reliability and performance. - Analyze financial data to provide insights and support strategic decision-making. What we look for - Experience: 3-5 Years. - Need to assess, design, and develop a working SAP FSCD solution for our global clients. - Business requirements management on the Insurance Business process, translate functional requirements into solution design. - Design of functional and technical concepts in SAP FSCD Interact and communicate with the Onshore Process leads and in some cases the end client as well as part of the implementation cycle, Good functional knowledge in the areas of financial accounting within the financial services industry. - Experience in SAP FS Collection and Disbursement (FSCD) with excellent understanding of Key accounting processes of FSCD and standards in insurance industry. - In depth knowledge of master data and transactional data in FSCD. - Knowledge on key FSCD processes such as KCLJ, invoicing, dunning, payment plan, payment run, broker reports, payment lots, return lots, document posting, subledger account determination, collection agency, reversals and write offs. - Should be familiar with integration of FS-CD with Key SAP insurance modules (FS-CM, FS-PM, FS-RI and FS-ICM) and SAP Finance modules SAP FI Experience with ECC GL and any financial General ledger experience relating to SAP insurance / banking products is added advantage. - Must have worked in at least one to two end to end SAP FSCD implementations. - Techno functional experience preferred with ABAP knowledge (FQEVENTS, Mass activity framework, BDT). jobDescription: At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Job Description: Senior Manager, Data Architect (Oil & Gas/ Manufacturing) EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) Role Overview The Senior Manager, Data Architect (Oil & Gas/ Manufacturing) will lead end to end data architecture strategy, solution design, and implementation for global Oil & Gas clients. This role requires a seasoned data architecture expert with 15+ years of total IT experience, including 2–3 years of domain-specific exposure in Oil & Gas (upstream, midstream, or downstream). The candidate will drive data modernization, enterprise data platforms, and advanced analytics adoption as part of large-scale digital transformation engagements. Key Responsibilities Data Architecture & Strategy - Define enterprise grade data architecture blueprints, reference models, and design patterns for Oil & Gas clients. - Architect data platforms leveraging cloud ecosystems (Azure, AWS, GCP) with strong focus on scalability, security, data quality, and governance. - Design logical and physical data models, data flows, and integration architectures aligned to Oil & Gas business processes. - Establish architectural standards for master data, metadata, lineage, ontologies, and taxonomy frameworks. - Incorporate emerging technologies such as AI/ML, knowledge graphs, IoT/SCADA data pipelines, predictive analytics, and industry frameworks like OSDU. Solution Delivery & Technical Leadership - Lead cross functional delivery teams across data engineering, analytics, integration, and platform modernization. - Oversee end to end data platform implementations, ensuring architectural integrity, performance, and reliability. - Conduct technical design reviews, provide hands on guidance, and ensure adherence to best practices and enterprise architecture guardrails. - Partner with cloud, application, and domain teams to ensure seamless integration across enterprise systems. - Drive high quality deliverables by ensuring robust testing, validation, and deployment practices. Oil & Gas Domain Enablement - Apply data architecture principles to Oil & Gas business domains including: - Production operations - Asset management - Drilling and subsurface data - Pipeline operations - Refining and petrochemicals - Architect data ingestion and harmonization of time-series, geospatial, subsurface, and IoT data. - Advise clients on adopting Oil & Gas industry data standards, with a strong understanding of OSDU Data Platform and domain data models. Stakeholder & Client Management - Act as a senior advisor to client architecture leaders, supporting C level stakeholders with data-driven strategies. - Communicate architectural concepts to technical and non technical stakeholders with clarity. - Manage vendor engagements and technology partners to ensure alignment to EY standards and client objectives. - Contribute to proposals, pursuit teams, and thought leadership for Oil & Gas data transformation initiatives. Optimization & Continuous Improvement - Conduct architecture maturity assessments and define modernization roadmaps. - Identify opportunities for performance optimization, cost reduction, and data lifecycle efficiency. - Create reusable assets, accelerators, and frameworks to improve project delivery velocity across EY GDS teams. Required Qualifications - 15+ years of overall experience in data architecture, data engineering, and enterprise data management. - 2–3 years of hands on experience in Oil & Gas industry projects (upstream, midstream or downstream). - Proven experience designing and delivering large-scale cloud data platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP). Strong expertise in: - Data modeling (conceptual, logical, physical) - Data integration & ETL/ELT pipelines - Data governance and quality frameworks - Time-series, IoT, and real time data platforms - Experience with OSDU, SCADA/IoT data, geospatial datasets, and subsurface data structures preferred. - Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and client facing communication skills. - Experience leading distributed global teams and working in multi vendor environments. Preferred Skills - Experience with Oil & Gas analytics platforms, digital oilfield solutions, and asset performance systems. - Certification in cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP). - Experience with AI/ML use cases applied to O\&G operations and asset management. - Understanding of DevOps/DataOps, containerization, and microservices architecture. - Consulting experience in a global professional services environment (Big 4 experience is a plus). Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. As part of our Global SaaS business, you will work closely with the Operations Manager, Product Owner, Client Technology Team and broader product team to help ensure the smooth operation and deployment of GVRT and GTES globally. The Operations Associate will assist in executing established processes and procedures, ensuring timelines are met and contributing to the successful operation and growth of the GVRT and GTESsolutions.
